items.summary: fix(knowledge): match canonically equivalent NFC/NFD keywords (#195092) Fixes #195031. Match canonically equivalent Unicode keyword spellings with bounded query-time original/NFC/NFD alternatives. Preserve stored text, record identity, and original snippet offsets; keep the mixed-normalization phrase limitation documented. Validated by exact-head CI (run 43050714314), the contributor's candidate/base differential, and their isolated real-model Gateway save/search proof. The service regression is ported to the current record_detail contract.
